description: Every message in one thread you participate in, ordered by seq; thread_not_found if you are not (or no longer) a participant.

cursor.description: The seq to resume after; omit for the start.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins. Omitting it on a connection with no header returns tenant_key_missing (-32602).

name: host.msg.thread
